groups.saying_opens: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا اشتد البرد
صلى بنا أمير الجمعة ثم قال لأنس

notes: The gloss هو خالد بن دينار is left out
Yunus's route is the same saying with a different transmitter and a wording change: variant
Bishr's route is a different saying (the Friday prayer question): its own group; Anas is addressed but no answer is written, so the chain stops at Abu Khalda
